mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level is associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and increase equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high unemployment rate above 9.5% signals economic distress and reduced corporate earnings potential, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST > 550 and RSAFS > 350000.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of total nonfarm employment indicates a strengthening labor market and increased consumer spending, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 130000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95 indicates a weakening manufacturing sector and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 600 thousand units signals strong residential construction activity and economic growth, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 600.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low interest rates (FEDFUNDS) and low unemployment (UNRATE) signals a robust economic recovery phase, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND UNRATE < 5.0%.
